fields.name: Vāṇīnātha Paṇḍita (Gadādhara's brother)
fields.aka: Vaninatha Paṇḍit, Vāṇīnātha Brahmacārī, Vaninatha Brahmacārī, Jagannātha, Jagannātha Miśra
fields.notes:
Younger brother of Gadādhara Paṇḍita and of his branch; father of Nayanānanda and Hṛdayānanda; lived at Cāṁpāhāṭi (Prema-vilāsa 24). Other name: Jagannātha. «Vāṇīnātha Brahmacārī, a very great soul» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 12.82); «I praise the brahmacārī Vāṇīnātha, the great soul, shining among the devotees» (Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 17) — the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna gives both under «Vāṇīnātha Paṇḍita», so the record «Vaninatha Brahmacārī» was joined to this one (06-11-2026).

Father: Mādhava Miśra (father of Gadādhara). Mother: Ratnāvatī Devī (Navakumārī Devī). Elder brother: Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosvāmī. Sons: Nayanānanda, Hṛdayānanda.

Vāṇīnātha Vipra (Dvija Vāṇīnātha) of Cāṁpāhāṭi, of Lord Caitanya's branch, who installed the Gaura-Gadādhara deities there, has his own record: perhaps the same person.

fields.name: Vāṇīnātha Vipra (Dvija Vāṇīnātha) of Cāṁpāhāṭi
fields.aka: Vaninatha Bipra, Dvija Vāṇīnātha, Dvija Vaninatha, Vāṇīnātha Dvija
fields.notes:
A brāhmaṇa of Cāṁpāhāṭi near Navadvīpa, of Lord Caitanya's branch (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.114). He is said to have installed the Gaura-Gadādhara deities still worshipped there (Murāri 4.17.22; Caitanya-carita-mahākāvya 10.6; Jayānanda p. 2). He was at the festival of Dāsa Gadādhara at Katwa and of Narahari Sarakāra at Śrīkhaṇḍa (Bhakti-ratnākara 9.395, 10.414). In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kamalekhā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 195, 204; Nāmāmṛta-samudra 98). The record «Dvija Vaninatha» (same verses, same place) was joined to this one (06-11-2026).

Gadādhara's brother Vāṇīnātha Paṇḍita also lived at Cāṁpāhāṭi (Prema-vilāsa 24): perhaps the same person.
